decision: Agree with proposed bounded Task2 architecture; freeze exact canonical Task2 contract after Task1 reviewed implementation, before Task2 production edits

choices.sourceNominalAndSettlementNames: same declared name; Quantity and Amount remain distinct types
choices.liabilityPolicy: per-obligation immutable cap; initial principal plus cumulative successful accrual; repayment never restores capacity
choices.funding: exact complete same-step lender-to-debtor transfer consumed once
choices.periods: UInt64 index, explicit next period and checked boundary; no implicit catch-up
choices.numericPriority: checked UInt overflow, signed nominal range, cap, then capacity; full malformed-input admission precedes application
choices.authenticationLimit: local shape and cap data are unauthenticated; ledger must bind consent, terms, time, predecessor and aggregate nominal cap

independentChecks: Reviewed full schema/equations/oracles and confirmed current record literal syntax and separate work reserve in existing source
remainingGate: Scoped canonical schema/example/work review before Task2 authoring; fresh exact implementation audit after each task
